room.subtitle: TFSA, RRSP and FHSA room from your CRA figures and the money recorded in your plans.
room.load_error: The contribution room could not be computed.
room.empty_description: Mark your TFSA, RRSP or FHSA accounts with their CRA registration in Settings.
room.no_account: No account is marked as this plan.
room.error: The room could not be computed: {{detail}}
room.tax_estimate: Estimated tax on the excess so far: {{amount}}. The CRA charges 1% a month on the highest excess in each month; withdraw the excess to stop it.
room.unreadable_profiles: The figures you entered earlier could not be read. Enter them again.
room.footnote: Deposits into an RRSP that repay the Home Buyers' Plan or Lifelong Learning Plan do not use room, but are counted here as contributions.

tfsa.title: TFSA
tfsa.needs_start: Enter your TFSA room on January 1 from your CRA account, or the year you became eligible for an estimate.
tfsa.withdrawals_tip: Withdrawals come back as room on January 1 next year, not this year.
tfsa.before_start: Records dated before your starting year are left out: the CRA figure already includes them.

rrsp.title: RRSP
rrsp.needs_start: Enter the available contribution room from your latest notice of assessment.
rrsp.window: Contributions from {{from}} to {{to}} use this room. Earlier ones were on your last return.
rrsp.next_limit_tip: The most new room can be next year: 18% of this year's earned income, up to this limit, less any pension adjustment.
rrsp.cushion: Over the room, but within the {{amount}} the CRA allows without tax.
rrsp.before_window: {{amount}} contributed in the first 60 days of the year is already in your notice's figure.
rrsp.after_window: {{amount}} contributed after the window uses next year's room. Enter your newer notice's figure.
rrsp.outdated: This figure is for a year that has ended. Enter the one from your notice for {{year}}.

fhsa.title: FHSA
fhsa.needs_start: Enter the year you opened your first FHSA. Room starts that year.
fhsa.carryforward: Includes {{amount}} of unused room carried forward from last year.
fhsa.next_year: Room for {{year}} if nothing else goes in
fhsa.period_ended: An FHSA can stay open for at most 15 years. Check whether yours has closed.

issues.title: Not counted, or assumed
issues.description: Recorded money the figures above leave out, or count on an assumption.
issues.ASSUMED_DIRECT_TRANSFER: A transfer from or to another institution, assumed to be a direct transfer between your own plans (no room used). If it was money you put in, record it as a deposit.
issues.TRANSFER_UNCLASSIFIED_ACCOUNT: A transfer with an account that has no CRA registration set.
issues.TRANSFER_OTHER_HOLDER: A transfer with another holder's account.
issues.SPOUSAL_RRSP_CONTRIBUTION: A spousal RRSP contribution: it uses the contributor's RRSP room, which the app cannot tell.
issues.FHSA_WITHDRAWAL: An FHSA withdrawal. A qualifying withdrawal for a home does not change the room; a taxable one may.
issues.MISSING_FX_RATE: No Bank of Canada rate for the day of this record.

statement.title: Capital gains statement
statement.heading: Capital gains statement for {{year}}
statement.summary_provisional: This year includes a provisional loss: the figures can still change.
statement.summary_review: This year includes a denied loss split between registered and non-registered shares. Check it with an accountant.
statement.gain_before_rule: Gain or loss before the superficial loss rule
statement.note_provisional: Provisional: buying the security back within 30 days of the sale can still deny this loss.
statement.note_review: Check with an accountant: the denied loss was split between shares inside and outside registered plans.
statement.left_out_warning: These securities are in none of the figures above. Work them out separately before you file.
statement.how_to_report: List each disposition on Schedule 3, in the section for publicly traded shares, mutual fund units and other shares. The proceeds here are already net of commissions, so enter no outlays, or split the commission out if your slip shows gross proceeds. A positive taxable amount goes on line 12700 of your return; a net loss is not entered there, and the CRA records it for other years.
statement.method: Cost is the adjusted cost base averaged across all of this holder's non-registered accounts. Foreign-currency amounts use the Bank of Canada daily rate of each trade's day. Losses denied by the superficial loss rule are not deducted.
statement.print_hint: To save a PDF, choose Print and pick Save as PDF as the destination.
statement.empty: No capital gains or losses to report yet.
statement.export_failed: The statement could not be exported.
